What am I looking at? (plain-English glossary)
Cases
The one and only volume measure on this page, straight off the export's Cases column (6 bottles = 1 case, so a single bottle is 0.17 of a case). Every KPI, chart, table and drilldown is in cases.
Order
One line of the report = one account buying one product on one date. Counting orders for an account × product is literally how many times they bought it.
MTD / Prior Month
MTD is the current (partial) month in the data; Prior Month is the last complete one. MTD is also compared against the same calendar days of last year, never against a full month.
YTD / Prior-Year YTD
Jan 1 through the last date in the export, and exactly the same date range one year earlier — always a like-for-like comparison.
New placement
An account whose first ever order of that brand (within this report window) falls inside the period you're looking at.
Account universe
Every account on the assigned Wine & Spirits book — the denominator for “% of universe” in Retention, not just the accounts that already buy these brands.
Repeat buyer
An account that has bought this brand on 2 or more separate dates in the window — a real, ongoing customer rather than a one-time trial.
Velocity
Cases per month, averaged over the full report window. Higher = moving off the shelf faster at that account.
Brand line
The four sellable lines behind the placement-gap matrix: Bardstown Origin Series, Bardstown Discovery/Collab, Green River Core, and Green River Single Barrel/Specialty.
CORE
The brand's flagship SKU set. An account "carries the CORE" only when it has bought every CORE SKU at least once. Green River CORE = Bourbon, Full Proof, Rye, Wheated, Honey (5). Bardstown Bourbon CORE = Bottled-in-Bond, Bourbon, Double Barrel Rye, High Wheat (4).
Near-CORE
An account that's carrying every CORE SKU except exactly one — the single easiest upsell to complete the set.
First-order size
Was the account's very first order a single bottle, a partial case (2-5 bottles) or a full case (6+)? The only place bottle counts appear — it's a question about order size, and it reports no volume of its own.
